anomalies.description: Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one initiates with a punch (f8), they grapple and struggle (f9–f11), then one lifts the other into a truck (f12–f13), followed by continued grappling on the ground (f14–f15).

Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat near a vehicle with vertical bars; one man (in lighter jacket) throws a punch and grapples with another (darker clothing), culminating in a takedown or struggle on the ground.; Two men in dark jackets physically restrain a third person wearing a hooded coat; they grab arms and torso, maneuvering the individual in a coordinated manner across multiple frames.

A hooded individual is restrained by two men; their hands are visibly bound behind their back (e.g., f12–f14), and they are being forcibly moved and controlled, indicating a non-consensual capture or subjugation without resistance capability.
A man on the left draws and aims a handgun directly at the restrained individual; the gun is clearly visible in his hand, pointed forward in a firing posture.

At f15, a man points a handgun directly at another person’s head/upper torso; the gun is held firmly in a firing stance, and the muzzle is aligned with the target—this constitutes visual evidence of an imminent or ongoing shooting act.

After the gun is aimed, the restrained individual is struck or shoved violently (visible recoil/motion blur in f8–f9), then collapses to the ground (f10), while the two assailants disengage and move away, indicating a helpless victim being attacked.
Immediate physical struggle occurs as the restrained person reacts to the gun threat—arms flail and bodies shift rapidly (f8–f9), consistent with defensive combat against armed coercion.
